items.title: Supercharging AI Agents: Build a Git-Based Engineering Knowledge Framework in 20 Minutes
items.summary: Imagine deploying AI agents that troubleshoot production incidents, generate pull requests, and execute engineering tasks faster than your team can document its decisions. Now imagine those agents relying on outdated architecture, contradictory discussions, or proposals that engineers already rejected. What happens when an AI agent confidently acts on knowledge your team knows is wrong?
